Original Decipher card face for [[3,720 To 1|3,720 To 1]], as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Edits: cropped to the black card border, and the corner pads outside the border set to white. The card face itself is unchanged.

The Holotable face used on the card page is [[:File:Dagobah-D-3720to1.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
